description.en: Control Shelly smart-home devices (Gen1, Gen2/Plus/Pro, Gen3 and Gen4) over your local network. Relays and plugs as switches, dimmers, RGB/RGBW/CCT bulbs and LED controllers as lights, roller shutters and blinds (with tilt) as covers, Wall Display and BLU TRV thermostats as climate, power/energy/voltage/current/temperature/humidity/illuminance/battery sensors, door/window, motion, flood and smoke binary sensors, virtual components, scripts, reboot and firmware-update buttons, Wall Display media player and a full remote for activities. Realtime push over WebSocket for Gen2+ devices. No cloud account required.

value.en: On the next screen your Shelly devices are discovered automatically. Leave the IP address blank to auto-discover, or enter it manually. If the device is password protected, enter the password (and the username for Gen1 devices). Repeat the setup to add more Shelly devices.
